title: Security of Generic AE Schemes A9–A12
summary: For generic nonce-based AE schemes A9–A12, neither strong security bounds nor insecurity was established; each must be given such a bound or shown insecure.

formal_statement.body: For each $A_i$ ($9 \le i \le 12$), prove a strong security bound or establish insecurity.

scope.domain: Security classification of generic nonce-based authenticated-encryption compositions.
parameters: i: index identifying each scheme from A9 through A12
scope.unresolved_remainder: For every scheme A9–A12, prove a strong security bound or establish insecurity.

citations.label: Authenticated Encryption in the Face of Protocol and Side Channel Leakage

progress.summary: The source lists A9–A12 as four unresolved cases, reporting that neither strong security bounds nor insecurity had been established.
